title: Docs got easier to navigate
summary:
A garden-maintenance day: clearer docs, cleaner contribution paths, and telemetry put back on its rails.

Authentication guidance and the main project README were expanded, while API docs now show the canonical model names without breaking existing alias-based requests. Less scavenger hunting; old integrations keep working.

Developer project labels and automation were broadened, and the app submission workflow received a syntax update to keep contributions moving through the pipeline.

Analytics meter tracking was restored so internal usage signals remain correctly separated and observable. The pipes continue doing pipe things.
